scenes.narration: Do you have a busy season coming up? Or maybe you are someone that's been serving for years and you want to take a step back? Break Requests are an easy way to let your leader know.
Scroll to Need a Break. Request Break is for a trimester. Blackout Dates is for specific days you already know you cannot serve.
Choose I need a break when you cannot serve that trimester. Choose Willing to take a break if you need it when you can still play but will step back if the schedule needs it.
Then pick your campus, ministry, trimester, and year, and tap Confirm.
The request stays under Pending Requests until a leader reviews it. Tap the X if you need to take it back.
Use Blackout Dates for a wedding, a trip, or any day you cannot play. Those dates apply across your campuses and ministries, so you only enter them once.
